finding.claim: Unsubscribe does not guard against missing callback: subs.indexOf(callback) can be -1 on double-unsubscribe, and splice(-1,1) removes an unrelated subscriber.
finding.title: Unsubscribe splice without index check corrupts subscriber list

verifier.reason: The unsubscribe returned at cache.ts:59 is `subs.splice(subs.indexOf(callback), 1)` with no -1 check, so a second invocation splices at -1 and removes the last unrelated subscriber.
